text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (My father is a very kind man.)

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Huh, they gave me the wrong change... Oh
well. Everyone makes
mistakes, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But Dad, if you don't speak up, the
shopkeeper will probably get in
trouble
after they count up the money.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right. They tally the amounts at the
end of the day, don't they. Thanks,
Flower. I'll let them know.
Uh... Excuse me.
I'm sorry, but—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(He's so kind, he'll apologize even for
things that aren't his fault.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(My mother is a very warmhearted
Umamusume.)

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh good, they still have the limited
edition macarons! We can buy
some to
share.
Excuse me, could I get—

text_block_list.name: Customer
text_block_list.text:
Omigosh, they still have the limited
flavors! I've been wanting to try
them ever
since I saw them in a magazine... Oh!
S-sorry. Were you going to buy them?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, er... No. Not at all. I was just
browsing...
Sorry, Flower... Why don't we
find another dessert?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But Mom, you said you wanted to try
those macarons... Should I let
the lady
know I want to buy them?

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it, dear. We should let
someone who really wants the macarons
have them. More importantly, is there
something you
want to eat?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(She's the kind of person who'll always
put
others before herself.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(But sometimes, my kind and warmhearted
parents would look at me
with a sad,
apologetic look in their eyes.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "We're sorry we can't do more for you."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(But you do more than enough. Whenever
I'm with you, my heart feels as warm as a
spring breeze. That's why I want you to
keep smiling—your smiles are like the sun
to me.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(I wondered what I could do to make them
smile. One day, the answer
came to me.)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The contestants in the Li'l Runners
exhibition race are really giving it
their all!
Oh? What's this? Nishino Flower closes the
distance at lightning speed, getting in
front!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Flower... She's looking straight ahead at
the finish line. I've never
seen her look so
confident...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Amazing...
The way she's running right past
everyone without worrying
about what's
going on around her...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Flower! You've got this!
We believe in you,
Flower!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You're almost there! Just one more burst
of speed and—yes! Way to
go, Flower!
You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Look at her go! She's flying ahead of the pack! And there you have it! Nishino Flower crosses the finish line to take first place!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew. Mom, Dad, I'm back. I was really surprised to hear your cheers! I don't think I've ever heard you yell like that—

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
You were incredible! Who knew there was
so much power hiding in
that little body! I
can't even begin to tell you how happy I
am... I'm so proud of you!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way! The cheers from
the crowd were deafening! We're so
proud—we couldn't help telling everyone
how amazing our
little girl is!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
It's hard to describe, but seeing you race
gave me a burst of confidence. It was
really something,
seeing our little treasure shine so
brightly.

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. You gave us courage. There's no
need to hide ourselves, to make ourselves
small—we should be holding our heads up
high
instead.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...My running... did that?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(My kind and warmhearted parents were
smiling brightly, like the sun
over a field of
flowers.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Mom! Dad! I...
I want to run more! I want to
enter more races!

text_block_list.name: Flower's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Then you have our full support! You'll
need a good pair of shoes first.
And you'll
also need...

text_block_list.name: Flower's Father
text_block_list.text:
A place where you can train and run to
your heart's content! We might
as well buy
some land, big enough to build facilities
on and—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If seeing me run makes my parents smile
like that, then I want to run
lots. I want
everyone who sees me to sparkle like the
sun.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
(If I can give everyone courage by
racing...
and if I can keep making
Mom and Dad
happy like this...)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Then I'll make it my dream.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How long has it been since I came to the
academy as a trainer? As
usual, after the
tryouts, I approach prospective trainees.

text_block_list.name: Girl with Braids
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! I've already chosen someone. It's
just that... I'd prefer to work
with a
seasoned trainer...

text_block_list.name: Girl with Short Hair
text_block_list.text:
Um, you're a new trainer,
right? I'm sorry...
Now's not a good time for
me...

text_block_list.name: Senior Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, no need to get so down in the
dumps! Keep at it, and I'm sure
you'll find
your perfect trainee!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know that many new trainers face the
same hurdle, but it still hurts
knowing just
how much my lack of experience is holding
me back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Still feeling blue, I walk the academy
grounds in a daze, when...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I trip over my own two feet and crash to
the ground. Looking at my
throbbing,
skinned knee, my mood sinks even lower.
A-are you all right?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Oh no! You're hurt... Can you make it over
to that bench?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
But that scrape looks really painful...
Oh,
feel free to lean on my
shoulder! It's all
right, I am an Umamusume after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After making sure I'm not hurt otherwise,
she begins expertly patching
up my knee. I
watch her work, impressed with her
efficiency.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There. I've disinfected the wound and put
a bandage over it. Um, I
hope that helped.
Can you walk?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, you're welcome. You should head to
the infirmary if it still
hurts, though. Well,
goodbye!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I stare at the cutesy floral print bandage
on my knee. That girl looked awfully
young, but she was wearing the Tracen
Academy uniform, so she must be a
student.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though I didn't exactly put my best foot
forward back there, her
kindness soothed
a bit of my melancholy.
